title: Special Topics in Geography; Programming for Image Analysis
description: Introduces application programming interface (API) functions and image processing techniques for efficient processing of satellite images. The main programing language of the course is Python. The course will use a Geospatial Data Abstraction Library (GDAL) which provides a unified way of manipulating images incorporating geospatial information. For image image processing, the course will use Python-based libraries such as scikit-image and OpenCV.
